title: Matching, alternating path, augmenting path, and cover
caption: Use the tabs to highlight the same bipartite graph in several different ways.

views.label: Graph
views.description: The graph is bipartite: every edge goes from the left side to the right side.

views.label: Matching
views.description: A matching is a set of edges that do not share endpoints. The blue edges form a matching of size 2.

views.label: Alternating path
views.description: The dashed arrows show the path direction, and the numbered vertices show the order along the path. The path alternates between edges outside the matching and edges inside the matching.

views.label: Augmenting path
views.description: The dashed arrows and numbered vertices show the order of this alternating path. It starts and ends at unmatched vertices, so it can increase the size of the matching.
views.afterDescription: After flipping the status of the edges along the path, the matching has size 3.

views.label: Vertex cover
views.description: The purple vertices touch every edge in this graph. This cover has size 3, matching the maximum matching produced by the augmenting path.
